d: Tejashwi Yadav Sanjay Yadav : kya tejasvi yadav aur unke sabse karibi dost sanjay yadav ke bich dosti men darar aa gaee hai? kya lalu parivar men mache ghamasan ka asar ab tejasvi ki sabse majbut rajnitik sajhedari par bhi parne laga hai? aakhir aisa kya huaa ki tejasvi yadav ke 37ven janmadin par unke sabse bharosemand sathi sanjay yadav hi gayab najar aae.... na janmadin ke jashn men pahunche, na koee mulakat huee aur na hi soshal midiya par badhaee ka ek shabd likha.... to kya ye mahaj ek ittephak hai ya phir iske pichhe koee bari siyasi kahani chhipi hai... kyonki jis sanjay yadav ko…
